images.name: Рабочая задача
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: production-quality Russian desktop webpage BODY mockup, 2560 × 1600 landscape screenshot, flat straight-on pixels, no browser frame, NO site header or footer.
Primary request: Design “Рабочая задача”, a genuinely utilitarian learning-program workspace for individual Tekla Structures training. Reference image 1 is ONLY existing Topengineer brand grounding (navy #16222d, yellow #ffc64b, Roboto/Archivo type), NOT layout to repeat. Reference image 2 is only the course's authentic classroom photo asset, not required in this particular design. Create a radically different THREE COLUMN full-width working surface with small 32px outer gutters and thin separators. NO marketing hero, no photo banner.
At top a compact breadcrumb “Учебный центр / Tekla Structures”, then “Рабочая задача” in bold 56px navy and subtitle “Индивидуальное обучение Tekla Structures”. Small facts in one line “2 дня · 16 часов · Онлайн / Москва”.
Below, fill the screen width with LEFT navigation 390px, CENTER program 1320px, RIGHT facts 650px with 32px gaps. Main content begins immediately, no whitespace-heavy banner. Left column label “ЧЕМУ ХОТИТЕ НАУЧИТЬСЯ”, three large vertically stacked simple nav rows with native outline icons: “Модель”, “Соединения” (active yellow vertical edge, navy tint), “Чертежи и отчёты”. Under it level segmented control with “С нуля”, “6+ месяцев”, “4+ года”, selected “С нуля”. Small bottom text “Смена задачи показывает связанные темы программы”.
CENTER large headline “Соединения и компоненты”, an explanation limited to 65-character lines, then full-width source-topic module rows, grouped “День 1 / Моделирование” and “День 2 / Проверка”. Exact selected topic names: “Болтовые соединения”; “Понятие сборка”; “Инструмент Сварка”; “Понятие компонент”; “Создание собственного простого компонента”; “Редактор компонентов”; “Создание привязок в компоненте”; “Создание формул в редакторе компонентов”; “Создание собственных переменных”; “Создание сложного параметрического компонента”; “Практика создания разнообразных компонентов”; “Перенос компонентов в другие проекты”. These are source curriculum headings, render cleanly without invented testimonials/results. Open first module as a white panel with small blue-gray border, overview and readable four-topic list; remaining modules closed accordion rows with counts, accessible chevrons. Lower center a low-emphasis text link “Все 65 тем базовой программы”.
RIGHT quiet pale gray summary titled “Ваш курс” with level, duration, format; simple participant stepper showing “5 участников”. Price very large “90 000 ₽”, caption “за группу · 2 дня”, second fact “18 000 ₽ за человека”. Below smaller parallel facts “1 участник — 40 000 ₽” and “3 участника — 70 000 ₽”. Yellow sole primary CTA “Обсудить обучение”, underneath outlined “Полная программа”. Fine print short “Онлайн или офис в Москве. Выезд к заказчику — по согласованию. Цена не зависит от уровня.”
At bottom of right summary, contact “+7 (495) 215-07-79”. Typography crisp, every functional label legible in Russian, comfortable 24px body at 2560px. Navy ink on white, slightly tinted compact right rail, no rounded sales cards, no full-width marketing photo. Preserve strong visual hierarchy; no invented names, schedules or reviews. No numeric design-option identifiers anywhere. Do not stretch or warp any UI. Show a complete believable 1600px viewport with no clipped words or overlapping columns.
